findings.title: Website details bypass the untrusted-user restriction
findings.body: `website_name` is serialized as a public attribute but is not included in `untrusted_attributes`. For a TL0 user viewed anonymously, the serializer can therefore expose the website host and path through `website_name` even when it omits the protected `website` field. This leaks profile information despite the existing restriction; apply the same inclusion restriction to `website_name` and cover it in the anonymous-user spec.
